title: tls_openssl Module
content_markdown: This module implements TLS operations using the [_openSSL_](https://www.openssl.org/) libarary. It provides the primitives required by the _tls\_mgm_ module in order to expose a higher-level API used by TLS-based protocol modules like _proto\_tls_ or _proto\_wss_ etc.
